_extraction_flags.notes: EXCLUDE: Pure sensing paper (Ocean Salinity using Tapered FMF at 2um). No communication data transmission demonstrated. Comm/Sensing mixture is mentioned only as future work. Note: The visual_analysis.txt for this paper seems to describe a completely different system (DAS+DWDM), suggesting a file mismatch, but the paper text is clearly Sensing Only.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Text Figures description: Fig.1: Salinity sensing setup with adiabatic-tapered FMF. Fig.2: Dispersion curves. Fig.3: Sensitivity results. (Note: The visual_analysis.txt file describes a different DAS+DWDM system, which contradicts the text captions. Relying on text content.)
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: All-optical fiber salinity sensor. Mechanism: Modal interference in tapered FMF (LP01/LP02 modes) at 2um band. Application: Ocean salinity monitoring.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Sensing: 1200.7 nm/RIU sensitivity. Salinity sensitivity 0.192 nm/ppt. 0-50 ppt salinity range. No communication metrics (BER, Data Rate) reported.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: High-sensitivity salinity sensor resilient to pressure/temperature. Gap: None relevant to ISAC. Capability for ISAC is theoretical future work ('could be further developed to mix communication').

bibliographic.title: Low Crosstalk Deep Ocean Salinity Monitoring at 2 µm Wavelength Band
bibliographic.authors: Yahao Li, Quandong Huang, Chaoyue Wang, Yu Huang, Wanyu Wu, Jiaqi Ran, Yanping Li, Jun Xue, Sławomir Ertman, Chenxu Lu, Ou Xu, Xinyong Dong, Tomasz R. Wolinski, Perry Ping Shum

application.scenario_description: Deep ocean salinity monitoring using optical fiber sensors.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Demonstration of 2um band adiabatic-tapered FMF salinity sensor with low crosstalk from pressure/temperature.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Ocean salinity sensing accuracy and cross-sensitivity issues.

transmitter.notes: ASE source around 2um (793nm pumped TDF). Sensing only.

receiver.notes: OSA (Optical Spectrum Analyzer) for spectral dip monitoring.

channel_fibre.notes: Point sensor (sensing head). Transmission length not main focus.
